{{Top}}
{{Quote|Three tons of duracrete reduced to rubble by the business end of an MTT&hellip;|Hexler Pend|<ref name="negvav">''[[The New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>}}
'''Duracrete''' was a dense building material. It was a fluid material that could be poured into any form and then hardened, resulting in a virtually impervious surface.

It was the [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] of [[Duracrete slug/Legends|duracrete slugs]].

[[EVS Construction Droid]]s were capable of producing compressed blocks of duracrete.<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> Both [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] and duracrete were used for the buildings of [[Bartyn's Landing]].<ref name="R">{{GamerCite|7|Reckonings}}</ref>
